name: Pennies from Heaven
description: Pennies from Heaven is a Hand and Foot Canasta variant. 6 players, 4 packs+8 jokers. Four canasta types: natural(500), mixed(300), wild(1000), sevens(1500). Draw 2 per turn. Must complete one of each canasta type to go out. 13 hand + 11 face-down foot. 20,000 to win.

content.text: Pennies from Heaven is a Hand and Foot Canasta variant. 6 players, 4 packs+8 jokers. Four canasta types: natural(500), mixed(300), wild(1000), sevens(1500). Draw 2 per turn. Must complete one of each canasta type to go out. 13 hand + 11 face-down foot. 20,000 to win.

Pennies from Heaven is the name used in card game literature for a distinctive North American variety of Canasta related to Hand and Foot. Almost identical rules appear in the US Playing Card Company's Official Rules of Card Games and in John Scarne's Encyclopedia of Games. Related variants include Railroad Canasta and Bain Hand and Foot (Barbara Bain).
4 packs, 8 jokers. Twos and jokers wild.
13 each + 11 face-down (foot). Top of stock turned for discard.
